text:
maria: heads-up — our Expo client using @redwood/inference-js v0.12 is flaky on edge runtimes. streaming responses start then never yield data, and Hermes console shows repeated `getrandom` errors. anyone seen this?

sam: can you paste the small repro or logs? is this on Expo Go or a bare workflow build?

maria: Expo Go, sdk 49. quick log + package excerpt: 
```
Hermes: Uncaught Error: getrandom: not implemented
  at polyfill (node:crypto)
  at fetchStream (src/api/stream.ts:42)
```
package.json deps: `@redwood/inference-js@0.12.0`, `react-native@0.71`, `expo@49.0.0`

ryan: two things hit me: 1) edge runtimes and RN/Expo don't expose Node builtins (crypto/getrandom, stream) so ESM packages that assume Node break; 2) SDK streaming uses WHATWG ReadableStream vs RN environment sometimes returning a different stream shape.

anya: fwiw we hit a similar issue: token auto-refresh retries were using `AbortController` signals to cancel in-flight fetches and RN/Expo fetch impl in older expo/go versions ignored stream consumption if fetch aborted early — produced hangs.

maria: interesting — how do we unblock on the app side short-term?

ryan: pragmatic checklist to try in order: 
- install `react-native-get-random-values` + import it at app entry so `crypto.getRandomValues` is present.
- add `expo-crypto` for HMAC/other crypto ops used in auth glue.
- polyfill URL/URLSearchParams with `react-native-url-polyfill` if you see URL issues.
- ensure global `ReadableStream` exists: `global.ReadableStream = globalThis.ReadableStream || require('web-streams-polyfill/ponyfill').ReadableStream` in dev builds.
- if using Expo Go, try a dev client build for deterministic behavior.

sam: can you show minimal code where streaming is invoked?

maria: sending snippet — this is how we call streaming: 
```js
const res = await client.chat.stream({ model: 'redwood-optim', prompt });
for await (const chunk of res) {
  // update UI
}
```
we get first chunk then nothing.

ryan: that `for await` expects an async iterable. On edge/runtime polyfilled ReadableStream you sometimes need to call `res.body?.getReader()` then `reader.read()` loop. SDK historically returned an async iterable that assumes Node `stream.Readable.from` semantics. There's an open PR to normalize to WHATWG streams for RN.

anya: TypeScript note — consumers hit errors like "Property 'tee' does not exist on type 'ReadableStream'". Workaround is adding `"lib": ["ESNext", "DOM"]` in tsconfig or add `skipLibCheck` until SDK types land.

maria: tried the getrandom + web-streams polyfill + url polyfill — progress! streaming works intermittently and auth retries still cause a hang when 401 -> token refresh -> retry flow.

ryan: the auth retry loop in SDK uses fetch+AbortController to cancel an in-flight stream before starting token refresh. On RN's fetch implementation that can leave the underlying socket open and the SDK's retry path waits for stream close. We changed the SDK in 0.12.1-rc2 to: 
- avoid aborting the original fetch when doing token refresh (use a separate non-streaming token-refresh fetch)
- detect non-WHATWG reader shapes and fallback to manual `getReader/read` flow

maria: where can I get 0.12.1-rc2?

ryan: link: https://npmjs.com/package/@redwood/inference-js/v/0.12.1-rc2 (internal canary packaged with edge polyfill fixes). we also added a small RN/Expo readme under `examples/expo-edge` that shows the exact imports.

dev-bot: CI for canary package passed on expo-example (build #782): ✅

sam: TL;DR for app devs: add `react-native-get-random-values`, `react-native-url-polyfill`, a web-streams ponyfill, and try the 0.12.1-rc2 canary. If you still see hangs, collect Fetch logs and Hermes stack traces and drop them here.

maria: confirming — after applying polyfills + rc2 canary and switching to dev client build streaming is now reliable. Auth-retry hang fixed. thanks all :thumbsup:

anya: follow-up: we'll add an entry to the SDK troubleshooting docs (devex:expo-edge) covering these polyfills and the TS lib tip. also open a small GH issue to track making the SDK ship a tiny RN compatibility shim automatically.

ryan: I'll open the issue and link the canary -> main patch.

maria: putting the repro and resolution steps in the Expo app repo's README now.

sam: nice. closing the loop. :rocket:
